name: IOF 2.0
description: The IOF brand as light: translucent plates tinted from IOF Blue with the brand pattern drifting inside, white class tabs and red accents, a band of light on entry, red-over-green hairlines, Franklin Gothic Heavy numerals, the white IOF logo. Elevation: a runner on the way rises as a white card above the plate and settles down when the time is confirmed.
author: Split Control, after the IOF broadcast graphics guidelines
fonts: Libre Franklin (OFL) stands in for Franklin Gothic Heavy and Book
